title: Architect an Aria-to-VCF management-component migration
prompt:
We have just added workload domain `wld-apps-02` to the existing Northstar Central VCF fleet. The Aria estate listed in `fixtures/estate-inventory.json` is hosted there and must become VCF Operations, VCF Automation, and VCF Operations for Logs 9.0.2 without changing the management domain. I need an executable architecture, not a narrative recommendation.

Research first using your real network tools. Consult current, reachable Broadcom-published material for the supported source-to-target paths, content/configuration compatibility, sizing, upgrade order, and end-of-general-support boundaries for every inventoried source product and version. Choose the Broadcom sources yourself; no particular URL or search query is prescribed. Record the exact pages you actually consulted, access date, and the decision each informed in `research-sources.md`. If current publication differs from the pinned authority, record the difference there. Do not replace genuine network research with the local snapshot.

For the deterministic architecture, `specs/compatibility-snapshot.json` is the pinned grading authority even if a live matrix has since changed. Do not edit it, the estate fixture, the schema, or the verifier.

Build a PowerShell module at `VcfAriaMigration/VcfAriaMigration.psd1` and `VcfAriaMigration/VcfAriaMigration.psm1`. Export exactly `Get-VcfMigrationPlacement` and `New-VcfAriaMigrationPlan`. The environment provides the declared VMware.Sdk.Vcf PowerCLI prerequisites; import and use them, including SDDC Manager domain/cluster discovery in `Get-VcfMigrationPlacement` and the VCF Installer specification initializers in `New-VcfAriaMigrationPlan`. Do not vendor VMware modules or install them from the module. `New-VcfAriaMigrationPlan` must accept `-InventoryPath`, `-CompatibilitySnapshotPath`, and `-OutputPath`, and deterministically write the architecture artifact.

Commit that generated artifact as `migration-installer-spec.json`. It must validate against `specs/installer-spec.schema.json` and be byte-identical when regenerated from the protected fixture and snapshot. In the artifact, include every source product and exact version, its target component/version and supported path, the end-of-support boundary, a complete disposition of every inventoried content/configuration ID (carry-forward method or abandonment reason), and the gates on every ordered migration step. Include final placement, topology, per-node sizing, availability mode, supported capacity, and aggregate resource fit for all target components. Every target placement belongs to `wld-apps-02` / `cluster-platform-services-02`; the management domain remains `observe-only`.

Run `pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File tests/verify.ps1` from the repository root. The verifier validates the local research record without making network requests; the pages listed there must be the current Broadcom sources you genuinely chose and consulted.
